change: deploy-release only inspects/pulls images selected by the requested app/admin scope
assertions: app scope inspects four app images, does not inspect admin, and tags four selected IDs
when app cache IDs differ, only the four approved app digests are pulled before tagging
admin scope checks and pulls only the approved admin digest and never contacts the other four images
an unapproved reference and failed preflight still refuse before Docker access
limitations: synthetic release proof verifier; this tests the deploy consumer's scope behavior, not real proof production
does not establish registry availability, image authenticity, a full positive release, or rollback runtime
